Character Voice LoRAs — MOSS-TTS Voice-Acting (4.55B)

One LoRA adapter per character class, trained on the chavo game-character corpus (75% class clips + 25% same-speaker reference mix, so voice cloning is preserved), rank 64. Each card plays two neutral English sentences with no reference — so you hear the raw timbre of the class, not an acted emotion. Every class was auto-annotated by Gemini 3.6 Flash (with thinking) from its two audio clips: a human-readable name, timbre profile (0–5), VoiceNet-style register/age/gender, distinctive features, and concrete casting suggestions across genres. The raw training identifier is kept as a small mono tag for traceability. Adapters: TTS-AGI/moss-race-loras.
